rationale.reason: Complete metal laser powder-bed-fusion machines fit additive manufacturing 8485; subtractive lasers and printed customer products are excluded.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This PCR covers manufacture of new complete configured metal laser powder-bed-fusion machines. Declare build envelope, laser/scan optics, platform, powder delivery/recoating, chamber/gas handling, control and actual delivered cooling/filtration modules. Exclude polymer printers, binder jetting, directed-energy deposition, electron-beam systems, subtractive laser tools, separately traded spares and whole customer printing cells. CPC44920 is broader than this boundary. Include actual factory calibration, chamber trials, test builds, cleaning/rework and their attributable material, energy and wastes. Customer metal-part production, routine powder/gas use, post-processing services, maintenance, lifetime and disposal are excluded. This is a machine-manufacturing reference, not a kilogram-of-printed-metal service.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Complete configured metal laser powder-bed-fusion machines
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Polymer/binder-jet/DED/electron-beam systems, subtractive laser tools, customer print cells and spare parts
reviewed_boundary.market_state: New complete accepted machine at factory gate, clean of test powder/coupons/residues; retained coolant declared; packaging separately inventoried

authored_review_metadata.semantic_boundary_decision: New complete configured metal laser powder-bed-fusion machine manufacturing record, narrower than CPC44920. Exclude polymer, binder jetting, directed-energy deposition, electron-beam and subtractive laser technologies, spare parts and customer cells. Local material index has no same complete LPBF machine methodology; subtractive laser tools and standalone lasers have distinct delivered product and manufacturing/test boundaries. Old scaffold and shared mapping untouched. Actual delivered chamber/laser/optics/platform/recoater/powder/gas/cooling/control modules, build plate and retained working fluids define M. Factory trials included, customer printed-part production excluded.
